Dashboards combine multiple reports into a single view — charts, KPI tiles, tables — so you can scan the metrics that matter most without clicking through every report.

  • Click Browse Dashboards to open the Dashboard Viewer.
  • Hover a chart to see exact values; click a segment to drill into the underlying records.
  • Use the dashboard-level filter bar to slice every component at once (e.g., filter by region, time period, owner).
  • Refresh manually with the Refresh button; dashboards do not auto-poll.
